name: an_sum_fib_odd
statement: (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Nat.fib (2 * i + 1) = Nat.fib (2 * n)
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Nat.fib (2 * i + 1) = Nat.fib (2 * n)
informal: Sum of the first n odd-indexed Fibonacci numbers is F_{2n}.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Nat.fib (2 * i + 1) = Nat.fib (2 * n)
